long_biography.plain_text:
Odunpazarı Modern Museum gave Erol Tabanca's collection a public home in a building designed by Kengo Kuma and Associates. Its stacked timber forms draw on the surrounding neighbourhood and the site's history as a wood market. The galleries bring together modern and contemporary works from Turkey and abroad.

Tabanca began collecting with an unplanned purchase of a small oil painting at an auction he attended with a friend. He continued to choose works that held his attention, following artists through exhibitions, galleries and fairs. His daughter İdil, who chairs the museum, also collects; father and daughter exchange views on possible acquisitions.

confidence.reason: The museum's actual opening release supports the architecture and collection; the August2026 direct interview supports the first acquisition, continuing practice and daughter exchange.
